name: Haoliang Huang
intro: I study how robots can use visual experience, language, and memory to learn new tasks. I am a master’s student in Robotics, Cognition, Intelligence at the Technical University of Munich, with a B.Sc. in Computer Science from KIT.
focus: My work spans VLA and world–action models, robot in-context learning, 3D vision, reinforcement learning, and distributed training. I build workflows for data generation and processing, and agentic systems that connect learned models to physical manipulation, planning, and simulation.

experience.title: Student Research Assistant · Agentic Driving & Rule Prediction
experience.organization: Technical University of Munich · Cyber-Physical Systems
experience.description: Developing a GPT-6.1 agentic planner for CommonRoad/SUMO, connecting language reasoning to numerical motion planning, set-based traffic prediction, and traffic-rule checks. Also working on Transformer-based neural prediction of time to traffic-rule violations.

experience.title: Research · Robot In-Context Learning & Embodied RSI
experience.description: After exploring the transfer of LLM-agent skills and memory to VLA policies in August, shifted to RICL / Zero-WAM in September. Building agent workflows for demonstration-video and action-clip data generation and processing. Beginning Embodied RSI research by studying algorithms for the RoboDojo competition Agent Track.

experience.title: Research · ManipArena, D4rtVLA & RoleWAM
experience.organization: Technical University of Munich · Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing
experience.description: A continuous research experience: the CVPR ManipArena challenge in April–May, the D4rtVLA prototype in June–August, and RoleWAM from September. Current work develops joint attention across visual inputs, task-role maps, and actions, and explores integration with RoboTTT’s memory mechanism.

experience.title: AI Intern · Intelligent Vehicle Dynamics Controls
experience.description: Designed a CAN-based foundation model architecture to estimate tire–road friction coefficients and other hard-to-measure vehicle dynamics parameters, with initial development on small-scale CAN-bus time-series datasets. Prepared and processed large-scale CAN-bus datasets for subsequent foundation-model training.

experience.title: Student Research Assistant · Cyber-Physical Systems
experience.description: Worked on CommonRoad competition management, algorithm design, autonomous-driving AI systems, and data processing.

awards.title: ManipArena Real-Robot Manipulation Challenge
awards.description: Built an agent + VLA manipulation system, combining learned control with visual planning, evidence verification, and unified robot action interfaces.

awards.title: Category-Level Object Pose Estimation in the Wild
awards.description: Integrated GCEPose and DINOv3 with geometric validation, category priors, and mixed PACE/Omni6DPose training.

awards.title: CommonRoad AI Programming Prize Challenge
awards.description: Designed a search-based motion planner for autonomous vehicles in CommonRoad scenarios.

projects.title: Neural Traffic-Rule Violation Prediction
projects.label: AI · Autonomous driving
projects.organization: Technical University of Munich · Cyber-Physical Systems
projects.description: Predicting time to traffic-rule violations with a Transformer and logistic-hazard decoder, using logical robustness, vehicle histories, and road context.

projects.title: Semantic-Aware 3D Reconstruction
projects.label: AI · 3D CV
projects.description: Integrated and benchmarked RaySt3R, VGGT, and VolSplat for semantic-aware 3D reconstruction. Contributed to model components and refinement, and led Slurm-based distributed training, large-scale HPC experiments, and scalable data generation pipelines.

projects.title: Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
projects.label: AI · Robotics · RL
projects.description: Adapted human-motion tracking to Booster T1 and built a hierarchical teacher–student pipeline for whole-body box interaction in simulation. Combined GMR retargeting, PPO, DAgger, and visual features with a reusable low-level tracker.

projects.title: π₀ Deployment & Real-World Benchmarking
projects.label: AI · VLA
projects.description: Deployed π₀ on LeRobot SO-101 and Franka robots. Built custom real-world datasets and designed experiments to evaluate vision-language-action policies in real scenes.

projects.title: Open-Vocabulary 6D Object Pose Estimation
projects.label: AI · 3D CV
projects.description: Built a zero-shot pipeline for unseen objects by combining Grounded-SAM-2 for open-vocabulary segmentation, InstantMesh / Trellis / Hunyuan3D for single-image 3D reconstruction, and Any6D for pose estimation.

projects.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning for Manipulation
projects.label: AI · Robotics · RL
projects.description: Built a KUKA sim-to-real adaptation workflow with calibrated dynamics, safety-constrained RL and continual learning. Compared four training strategies and evaluated retention across four reaching targets.

projects.title: Quantized Large Language Models
projects.label: AI · NLP
projects.description: Investigated 1-bit and 1.58-bit Transformer layers and trained a quantized BERT model on Toxic Comment Classification data. Compared the practical training and inference costs with the theoretical efficiency of low-bit computation.

projects.title: Variational Autoencoders for Image Generation
projects.label: AI · Generative models
projects.description: Compared VAE, CVAE, and Gaussian-process-prior VAE models on MNIST and FacePlace, studying latent-space structure, conditional generation, and identity/viewpoint-aware reconstruction.

projects.title: Benchmarking Inverse Kinematics Algorithms
projects.label: Robotics
projects.description: Benchmarked Cartesian-space controllers and open-source inverse kinematics algorithms for the Franka Emika robot. Worked with robotic manipulation platforms, controller systems, and MuJoCo.

projects.title: Interactive Robot Learning
projects.label: ML · Robotics
projects.description: Built an articulated MuJoCo kitchen and Blender assets for HoloLens, then explored Franka door opening through demonstrations and probabilistic movement primitives.

projects.title: An Experimental Platform for Outlier Data
projects.label: Software systems
projects.description: Contributed to Odex, a Django/MySQL web platform for running and comparing PyOD outlier-detection methods on user-uploaded high-dimensional data and feature subspaces.

projects.title: Mobile Robots Competition
projects.label: Robotics
projects.description: Programmed a LEGO robot to navigate a complex course, integrating multiple sensors and designing PID controllers for navigation.

projects.title: CNN-Based Traffic Surveys from Drone Video
projects.label: AI · 2D CV
projects.description: Fine-tuned YOLO detector families using VisDrone and evaluated them on custom annotated drone videos. Built a lane-aware tracker and directional vehicle counter to compare complete traffic-analysis pipelines.

featured_projects.title: RoleWAM
featured_projects.summary: Joint attention for visual inputs, task-role maps, and robot actions, with ongoing research into RoboTTT-inspired memory.
featured_projects.contribution: Developing the attention module, task-role representation, and training and evaluation workflow.

featured_projects.title: RICL / Zero-WAM
featured_projects.summary: Human demonstration videos as context for new robot tasks, supported by agent workflows for data generation and processing.
featured_projects.contribution: Designing reusable demonstration clips, robot-grounded data workflows, and controlled context-transfer experiments.

featured_projects.title: Agentic Driving & Rule Prediction
featured_projects.summary: A GPT-6.1 agent connected to motion planners, traffic prediction, and checked execution in CommonRoad/SUMO.
featured_projects.contribution: Building the agent–tool interface and evaluation system; also developing neural traffic-rule prediction.

featured_projects.title: D4rtVLA / InstructD4RT
featured_projects.summary: Adapting OpenD4RT to predict future key-object features for VLA action generation, followed by instruction-conditioned grounding.
featured_projects.contribution: Trained the future-feature prediction path and built InstructD4RT; discontinued the direction after finding limited generalization.

featured_projects.title: ManipArena · AI Agent + VLA
featured_projects.summary: A multi-task robot system combining a finetuned VLA with asynchronous subtask planning and evidence-based progress verification.
featured_projects.contribution: Unified tabletop/mobile action interfaces, LoRA adaptation, and concurrent planner–verifier orchestration.

featured_projects.title: Category-Level 6D Pose
featured_projects.summary: A GCEPose/DINOv3 challenge system built around trustworthy geometry, category shape priors, and mixed-dataset training.
featured_projects.contribution: PACE/Omni6DPose canonicalization, shape/semantic priors, data routing, and training experiments.
